items.question: What makes Beaniro coffee different?
items.answer: We use slow cold extraction, balanced syrups and freshly prepared cream finishes.

items.question: Do you take same-day orders?
items.answer: Yes, collection is available daily and local delivery depends on your postcode.

items.question: Are your ingredients locally sourced?
items.answer: Where possible, yes. We work with UK dairy partners and local bakery suppliers.

items.question: Do you have non-coffee options?
items.answer: Yes, our menu includes iced chocolate, tea coolers and seasonal specials.

items.question: Is Beaniro a good place to work or relax?
items.answer: Yes, we have calm seating, sockets, Wi-Fi and a relaxed daytime atmosphere.
